svg.title: Shape trace and parameter count of the 28 × 28 × 1 chain
svg.desc: Input 28 × 28 × 1, conv 25 filters 3 × 3 gives 26 × 26 × 25 (250 parameters), 2 × 2 pool gives 13 × 13 × 25 (0), conv 50 filters 3 × 3 gives 11 × 11 × 50 (11,300), 2 × 2 pool gives 5 × 5 × 50 (0), flatten 1250, dense 10 (12,510). Total 24,060.
